comparison.rule: advantage = baseline_ls - quantum_ghz4 (CEP50 m, TERCOM matches lost); d = 100 m - 400 m; CEP50 tie band 10 m; grows / shrinks / stays about the same / is mixed
comparison.statement: At 100 m on the synthetic map the quantum navigation advantage shrinks compared with the 400 m Eastern_395 flight: GHZ-4 vs LS baseline CEP50 advantage -0.9 m at 100 m vs +27.5 m at 400 m; TERCOM matches lost (LS baseline / GHZ-4) 1/62 vs 0/62 at 100 m and 10/62 vs 0/62 at 400 m. The signal-level advantage (39.1 nT vs 0.2 nT at 100 m) does not depend on the map.
